scope: Exclusive attribution of simulated instructions and conditional misses. Marginal estimates subtract the 50-operation profile from the 500-operation profile and divide by 450. Inlining may attribute work to callers or library files; source totals are not full component costs or projected savings.
report_selection: All category totals; top 30 source files, top 10 functions by instructions and by conditional misses per peer. Complete exclusive attribution and annotation output are in the archive.
